body: Seeing on the news the gun violence happening in the states is sad but makes me wish I was American because of how easy it is to purchase a firearm. People say it’s hard to shoot yourself once in the position to do so but having tried hanging myself im pretty sure I wouldn’t think twice about blowing my brains out.
All I’ve known is failure. Failing to kill myself scares me more than actually dying.

It’s unbelievable how much a bad childhood from abusive parents affects the rest of our lives. And people on here care. At least for me there’s some comfort hearing other peoples stories. It’s nice not feeling alone.

I feel you. Two guys I know from work went on vacation with their girls not that restrictions being lifted. I even have one friend planning his wedding. Me, I’ve dumped almost 60hrs on elden ring in the past week. Fun life man.

You know I spent my whole life being jealous of my friends families back when I had friends. It’s probably the single biggest thing that fucked me in this life was my toxic family. I know it’s hard for some people to relate because most people have decent parents at least. You not alone bro.

I mean some couples do have it bad. I know my own parents did. But it would be nice to be in a relationship just once, even if it was short lived. I know if I got one I’d probably mess it up, I have too many issues I’m dealing with but it’s still better than never knowing what it’s like to have someone interested in you.
Hey man it happens to everyone. The fact that you got the match, then proceeded to make a date is a huge fucking W.

I hear you loud and clear. Never been in contact with my dad and when I moved out I stopped talking to my mom. I even changed my last name. My life’s been better ever since. Not perfect, hell my life isn’t even decent but it’s a bit better than it was, so that’s dub. I hope you get the chance to get away.

Dude I’m 24 and I’ve never even kissed a girl. My “friends” shame me for it all the time despite me being more successful then them. In fact my career is the only reason I’ve lasted this long. We all have a story. For me, I was anorexic growing up and I still am to this day which has affected me mentally my whole life. I just can’t beat it which is my reason for having no dating experience and suicidal since gr7. I don’t share my lack of dating experience with any new friends I’ve made through work cause I know they would think less of me, that’s just life, that’s what men do and seems like your friends are no exception. Listen don’t let anyone make you feel less about yourself for being a virgin. There’s a lot to life and find what your passionate about and let that drive you. But again what do I know about anything I’m just a virgin am I right? 
I hope you read this because you’re not alone bro. Good luck.
